title: New Faces, Unexpected Surprises and Unfinished Business as 'Tuiskoms' Returns on 8 December
body_markdown:
FIRST-LOOK


[IMAGES](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/0c02332e-d344-4b33-9257-6e0993d14a82)


After capturing hearts in Season 1 with its exploration of love, family and the search for belonging,


Tuiskoms


returns to the picturesque coastal town of Wilderness, where familiar faces, fresh drama and new beginnings await its residents.


Wedding bells are ringing for Fleur (


[Amalia Uys](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm3246004/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_2_nm_6_in_0_q_amalia%20uys) ) and Werner (


[Armand Aucamp](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm4863166/) ), but an unexpected pregnancy throws their carefully laid plans into question. As the couple considers what this means for their future, others are also confronting difficult choices and unresolved matters from the past.


[Clint Brink](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm9582948/) and


[Kim Syster](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm5482418/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_1_nm_7_in_0_q_Kim%20Syster) join the cast as Brendon and Amy, two newcomers whose arrival brings a different dynamic to the close-knit community, sparking connections and complicating existing relationships.


Tuiskoms


Season 2 boasts an impressive ensemble of some of South Africa’s most recognisable acting talent, including newcomer


[Adri-Jo Waterboer](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm16368826/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_0_nm_1_in_0_q_Adri-Jo%20Waterboer) ,


[Zane Meas](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0575235/) ,


[Pierre Van Pletzen](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0887737/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_0_nm_2_in_0_q_Pierre%20Van%20Pletzen) ,


[Melissa de Vries](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm8377523/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_0_nm_5_in_0_q_Melissa%20de%20Vries) ,


[Jane De Wet](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm10391704/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_0_nm_8_in_0_q_Jane%20De%20Wet) and


[Cantona James](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm13069061/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0_tt_1_nm_7_in_0_q_Cantona%20James%20) . The second season of


Tuiskoms


premieres on Netflix on 8 December 2026 and runs for six episodes.


ENDS


Synopsis


When Fleur discovers unexpected news of a new arrival in her family, her carefully rebuilt life is upended, just as prodigal daughter Amy returns to Wilderness seeking redemption. A tight-knit community is forced to redefine what home, forgiveness and second chances truly mean.
